protocol.cohort: Every route listed in the audited route-tile file on each hash-verified SNMF explicit national no-fire report date in 2024.
protocol.no_fire_source: SNMF explicitly said no fires were reported nationally; this is an administrative report status, not physical no-fire truth.
protocol.independent_observation: Suomi-NPP VIIRS VNP14A1.002 daily L3 FireMask and QA at nominal 1 km.
protocol.spatial_unit: All pixels within 10 km of each complete route polyline.
protocol.clear_land_rule: FireMask class 5 and QA bits 0-1 equal 10.
protocol.model_alignment: Whether the frozen JMA model emitted an alert at the pre-existing diagnostic threshold 0.1; no score or threshold was tuned using VIIRS.
